doc: The glyph tables of python/excalicore/fontmetrics.py: per font its size, average advance, sum and a position-weighted checksum (`tables`), and single glyphs at 1000px (so the advance reads in thousandths of an em) at the edges of the tables and of every East Asian wide range (`textWidth`): a glyph the tables lack is the font's average, or 1000 when wide.
